bs_description: Generic metal powder bed fusion build style with full toolpath generation and export.
filter_lsr_layers: LSR toolpath (ZIP, one file per layer)
filter_cli_layers: CLI+ toolpath (ZIP, one file per layer)
grp_hull_core_descr: Splits the part volume into an outer hull and an inner core with its own hatching. The core can be exposed only every n-th layer.
grp_border_first_descr: Outermost contour of every island, shifted inwards by the beam compensation.
grp_border_following_descr: Additional contours (2nd to N-th border) inside the first border.
grp_fill_contour_descr: Contours between the borders and the hatching.
grp_overhang_descr: Areas without enough solid material below are exposed with downskin settings.
grp_upskin_descr: Areas that are not covered by the next layer are exposed with upskin settings.
grp_support_wall_descr: Exposure of supports that consist of open lines.
grp_support_solid_descr: Exposure of supports that consist of areas.
grp_scanning_descr: Laser, power, speed and focus of every vector type.
grp_laser_timing_descr: Jump speed and delays of the scanner. Used for the time estimation and the power optimization.
grp_gas_flow_descr: Direction of the protective gas flow on the platform.
grp_build_order_descr: Order in which models, islands and vector types are exposed.
grp_scanning_order_descr: Exposure order of the vector types.
grp_line_stipple_descr: Exposes the contour as dashes in several passes. Together the passes close the contour.
grp_start_point_descr: Moves the start point of closed contours so that the seams do not lie on top of each other.
grp_rotation_descr: Rotation of the hatch lines from layer to layer.
grp_rotation_limit_descr: Only hatch directions inside this window are used, for example to avoid exposing towards the gas flow.
grp_power_opt_descr: Adapts the laser power to the time the laser needs to return to the same area. Short vectors get less power.
grp_hatch_volume_descr: Hatching of the part volume, or of the hull if hull and core is active.
grp_hatch_core_descr: Hatching of the core. Only used if hull and core is active.
vec_border_first_descr: Scan settings of the first border.
vec_border_first_ds_descr: Scan settings of the first border in downskin areas.
vec_blocked_path_descr: Scan settings of the blocked paths (center lines of narrow regions).
vec_border_following_descr: Scan settings of the following borders.
vec_border_following_ds_descr: Scan settings of the following borders in downskin areas.
vec_fill_contour_descr: Scan settings of the fill contours.
vec_fill_contour_ds_descr: Scan settings of the fill contours in downskin areas.
vec_hatch_volume_descr: Scan settings of the volume or hull hatching.
vec_hatch_downskin_descr: Scan settings of the downskin hatching.
vec_hatch_core_descr: Scan settings of the core hatching.
vec_hatch_upskin_descr: Scan settings of the upskin hatching.
vec_part_open_path_descr: Scan settings of open lines that belong to the part.
vec_support_wall_descr: Scan settings of the wall supports.
vec_support_solid_descr: Scan settings of the solid supports.
order_descr: Vector types with smaller numbers are exposed first.
min_hull_thickness_descr: Minimum thickness of the hull around the core.
core_every_nth_layer_descr: 1 = core in every layer, 2 = core in every second layer, ...
beam_compensation_descr: Distance between the part outline and the center of the first border. Usually half of the melt pool width.
blocked_path_enabled_descr: Center lines for narrow regions where the compensated border disappears.
alternate_per_layer_descr: Reverses the scan direction of the contours in every second layer.
alternate_per_contour_descr: Reverses the scan direction for every second contour of the same layer.
border_count_descr: Number of borders after the first border.
fill_contour_count_descr: Number of fill contours between the borders and the hatching.
first_offset_descr: Distance between the innermost previous contour and the first contour of this group.
following_offset_descr: Distance between two neighboring contours of this group.
hatch_offset_descr: Distance between the innermost contour and the hatch area. Negative values let the hatching overlap the contour.
surface_angle_descr: Angle between surface and build plate. Regions with a smaller angle are downskin.
reference_layers_descr: Number of layers below that are checked for solid material.
overlap_descr: Distance by which the skin hatching extends into the neighboring volume.
border_splitting_descr: Borders inside downskin areas get the downskin scan settings.
fill_contour_splitting_descr: Fill contours inside downskin areas get the downskin scan settings.
support_inset_descr: The support area is reduced by this distance before it is hatched.
jump_speed_descr: Speed of the laser moves without exposure.
mark_delay_descr: Waiting time after every hatch vector and at the end of every contour or open path.
min_jump_delay_descr: Jump delay of a very short jump. Only used if the jump length limit is greater than 0.
jump_length_limit_descr: Jumps shorter than this get a delay between the minimum jump delay and the jump delay, in proportion to their length. 0 = every jump gets the full jump delay.
gas_flow_angle_descr: Direction in which the gas flows, measured counter-clockwise from the +X axis.
sort_models_descr: Models downstream are exposed first, so that spatter is blown onto already exposed areas.
build_order_mode_descr: Platform: each vector type on the whole platform. Model: all vectors of a model, then the next model. Island: all vectors of an island, then the next island. Global: each vector type on the whole platform; every hatch block and contour by its own position from downstream to upstream, parts and islands are no sort level.
layer_offset_descr: Shifts the exposed layers. Must be smaller than n.
stipple_overlap_descr: Overlap between consecutive dashes of different passes.
stipple_count_descr: Number of interleaved dash passes that together close the contour.
stipple_random_start_descr: Start the dash pattern at a random position.
start_point_mode_descr: Off: no change. Random: random start point. Previous layers: start point far away from the start points of the previous layers. Random + previous layers: random choice among the points that are far enough away.
history_layer_count_descr: Number of previous layers whose start points are avoided.
min_start_distance: Minimum distance to previous start points
min_start_distance_descr: A start point must have at least this distance to the start points of the compared layers.
start_angle_descr: Hatch angle in the first layer. 0 = hatch lines parallel to Y (stripes parallel to X).
angle_increment_descr: The hatch angle increases by this value from layer to layer.
limit_center_mode_descr: Relative to gas flow: the window direction is added to the gas flow angle. Absolute: the window direction is measured from the +X axis.
limit_center_angle_descr: Hatch angle in the middle of the window, same convention as the start angle (0 = lines parallel to Y). Relative mode: angle added to the gas flow angle (0 = lines perpendicular to the gas flow, exposed against it).
limit_width_descr: Total opening angle of the window. Hatch angles outside of the window are mapped into it.
min_power_descr: Power for vectors with a return time up to the vector length for minimum power.
max_power_descr: Power for vectors with a return time from the vector length for maximum power.
min_vector_length_descr: Vectors up to this length (converted to return time) get the minimum power.
max_vector_length_descr: Vectors from this length on (converted to return time) get the maximum power.
segment_splitting_descr: Splits vectors into short segments, each with its own power.
microvector_length_descr: Length of the segments for segment splitting.
merge_equal_power_descr: Neighboring segments with the same power are merged into one vector.
hatch_distance_descr: Distance between two neighboring hatch lines.
optimized_sorting_descr: Sorts the hatch lines in blocks against the gas flow, exposes the lines of each block against the gas flow and shortens the jumps.
blocksort_run_ahead_limit_descr: Maximum distance a block may run ahead of its neighbors.
blocksort_min_block_segments_descr: Blocks with fewer segments are merged with neighboring blocks.
blocksort_max_merge_distance_descr: Blocks are only merged if they are closer than this distance.
stripe_script_sort_descr: Exposes the stripes against the gas flow and connects the blocks inside a stripe with short jumps.
stripe_alternate_descr: Reverses the scan direction for every second stripe.
chess_size_descr: Edge length of one chessboard field.
offset_inside_out_descr: Exposes the offset rings starting with the innermost ring.
laser_index_descr: Number of the laser that exposes this vector type (1 = first laser).
power_descr: Laser power of this vector type.
speed_descr: Scan speed of this vector type.
focus_descr: Focus shift of this vector type (0 = in focus).
grp_scanner_array_descr: Scanners of a multi-laser machine and the size of the build platform. Only used when the laser assignment is enabled.
scanner_center_x_descr: X position of the center of the scanner grid.
scanner_center_y_descr: Y position of the center of the scanner grid.
scanner_count_x_descr: Number of scanners along X. The lasers are numbered row by row.
scanner_spacing_x_descr: Distance between the centers of neighboring scanners along X.
scanner_spacing_y_descr: Distance between the centers of neighboring scanners along Y.
scan_field_width_descr: Width (X) of the area that one scanner can reach, centered on the scanner.
scan_field_height_descr: Height (Y) of the area that one scanner can reach, centered on the scanner.
platform_min_x_descr: Lower X limit of the build platform. The swimlanes are cut from the platform limits.
platform_max_x_descr: Upper X limit of the build platform.
platform_min_y_descr: Lower Y limit of the build platform.
platform_max_y_descr: Upper Y limit of the build platform.
grp_laser_assignment_descr: Assigns every path to a laser of the scanner array and balances the work between the lasers.
laser_assignment_enabled_descr: Off: every vector type uses the laser number of its scan settings. On: the lasers are assigned and balanced automatically, and the preview shows one color per laser.
legend_laser_descr: Paths exposed by this laser (laser assignment).
assignment_strategy_descr: Field split: hatch vectors are cut at the scan field borders and balanced in the overlaps. Swimlane: whole paths are assigned band by band along the gas flow, downstream first. Swimlane + clipping: like swimlane, but hatch vectors are cut at the band borders first. Swimlane + reassignment: like swimlane, but every hatch vector moves uncut into the band of its middle point.
load_balance_metric_descr: Marked length: balances the marked length per laser. Exposure time: balances the estimated time per laser, including jumps and delays (laser timing).
proximity_weight_descr: 0 = pure load balancing. Higher values give vectors in an overlap preferably to the closest scanner.
swimlane_width_descr: Width of the bands along the gas flow. Only used by the swimlane strategies.
swimlane_split_polylines_descr: Only for swimlane + clipping: also cut contours and open paths at the band borders.
